description: VPS plans as /prices/vps/plans and GET /v1/vps/plans return them: the very same function, so the answers cannot differ for the same filters. Every row is a plan with its verified list price a month (excl. VAT) for the chosen contract term, all price points the provider states, buying facts (IPv4, traffic, disk and vCPU type; null = not stated), region (region_stated=false when the source names none), verified_at and source_url. Only plans with a price verified in the last 3 days carry a price; the others are listed apart in not_verified without one. Sorted by price (or per GB RAM, per vCPU); nothing is ranked for money. Each plan has a detail_url with its facts sheet. Answer pages for common searches: /prices/vps/cheapest.

dedicated.description: Only plans whose source states dedicated vCPUs
dedicated.title: Dedicated

ipv4.description: Only plans whose source states an own IPv4 address is included
ipv4.title: Ipv4

limit.description: Maximum plans returned, 1 to 500 (the same rows as the API; the API default is 200)
limit.title: Limit

max_price.description: Maximum price a month in the chosen currency
max_price.title: Max Price

nvme.description: Only plans whose source states NVMe disks
nvme.title: Nvme

region.description: A place key: eu, us, asia, a country code such as de or nl, or none (plans whose source states no region)
region.title: Region

term.description: Contract term: none = no commitment (default), 12 = up to 12 months, any
term.title: Term

traffic_tb.description: Minimum included traffic in TB a month (unlimited counts)
traffic_tb.title: Traffic Tb

name: vps_plans
title: VPS plans, filtered
